purpose: Test whether an open V10 LONG position should exit early after a completed-bar structural regime downgrade instead of retaining its entry-lane fixed time exit.
entry: next 15m open after the signal bar

policies.DOWNGRADE_1: BULL exits after one completed bar outside BULL; RANGE exits after one completed BEAR bar
policies.DOWNGRADE_2: same downgrade must persist for two consecutive completed bars
policies.DOWNGRADE_4: same downgrade must persist for four consecutive completed bars
policies.DEEP_1: BULL or RANGE exits only after one completed BEAR bar
policies.DEEP_2: BULL or RANGE exits only after two consecutive completed BEAR bars
policies.DEEP_4: BULL or RANGE exits only after four consecutive completed BEAR bars

transition_execution: market exit at the next 15m bar open after confirmation; if no confirmed transition occurs before the fixed exit, use the fixed exit
entry_set: identical V10-LANES-3.0.0 entry events for the same-entry comparison; a second sequential portfolio simulation must reapply cooldown, symbol exclusivity and global capacity using each policy's actual exit time
notes: A regime upgrade is not an adverse exit trigger because every V10 lane is LONG.
BEAR positions retain their tested time exit in this protocol; recovery from BEAR is directionally favorable to a LONG position.
No stop-loss, take-profit or parameter changes are permitted in this comparison.
